name: Leaf Cloak
description: Hold the sword in a wide cover stance with qi unbroken from grip to crossguard.

name: Fuller Maelstrom
description: Join a parry and a cut so the blade never leaves the foe's line between them.

name: Midribassault
description: Lift the forte against the foe's blade and thrust from beneath it with qi at the point.

name: Careening Envelop
description: Move in a step that keeps guard and cut joined so no gap shows.

name: Unbroken Foible
description: Turn the cover guard to meet cuts from two sides without a pause.

name: Riposte Thrash
description: Chain cut after cut from the guard line, qi unbroken in the sword arm.

name: Waningfoible
description: Sweep the blade in a full circle that turns the foe's blow back along his own line.

name: Quillon Barrage
description: Sweep the blade in a wide, flat arc to cut every foe within reach of the circling edge.

name: Midribthrash
description: Run qi the length of the blade and cut so the edge strikes with its full length.

name: Aegisfuller
description: Hold qi steady in the edge to resist blows that come against it.

name: Rumble Midrib
description: Gather qi at the point and thrust deeper than the blade's length alone.

name: Gust Crossbar
description: Step with qi shifting along the blade for balance in the lunge.

name: Tangthrash
description: Extend the edge's reach by a hand with qi flowing past the blade's tip.

name: Toxin Forte
description: Strike the foe's blade with the full flat and drive qi into his wrist.

name: Chimefoible
description: Wrap qi around the blade to catch and turn heavy cuts.

name: Leaftorment
description: Send a thin crescent of qi flying from the edge in a single cut along the line of the swing.

name: Beat Torment
description: Gather qi in the edge during a rise and let it fall in one heavy cut.

name: Compressing Tang
description: Slide the fuller along the foe's blade and beat it aside with a pulse of qi.

name: Charter Pommel
description: Press the flat against the foe's blade and hold it down with a steady flow of qi.

name: Iron Feint
description: Slip the point off the pressed blade and thrust into the open line.

name: Granite Pommel
description: Turn the flat to the foe and step across him with the point behind it.

name: Ricasso Assault
description: Slap the flat across the foe's face or hand to stagger him.

name: Thorn Fuller
description: Trap the foe's blade in the fuller's line and hold it with qi.

name: Chime Ricasso
description: Cover the body with the flat and let qi turn aside the cut.

name: Scorching Crossbar
description: Turn flat to edge in one motion and cut as the foe presses against it.

name: Shadefuller
description: Press the flat against a foe's guard and hold a surge of qi down it to keep his sword down.

name: Gust Cutover
description: Strike a blade with the fuller so a ringing shock numbs the foe's hand.

name: Ravaging Leaf
description: Cut from either edge in turn with qi ready in both.

name: Facet Quillon
description: Hold the guard inside the qi field that surrounds the blade.

name: Tearing Glissade
description: Thrust with the qi field gathered tight at the point.

name: Envelop Spurt
description: Step as the blade turns so the same edge keeps pace with the body.

name: Might Tang
description: Draw the blade across the foe with the reverse edge as the arm retreats.

name: Gustleaf
description: Shift edges mid-parry so the blade bites on the foe's blade instead of sliding.

name: Granite Cutover
description: Swap qi between the two edges in the middle of a cut and let the foe misjudge the blade.

name: Fastening Foible
description: Lock the foe's blade between both edges with a shell of qi.

name: Toxinpommel
description: Beat the foe's blade with a pulse from the qi field and open his guard.

name: Tearing Midrib
description: Sweep one edge and then the other in a sudden spin to cut all around the swordsman.

name: Facettang
description: Hold the qi field around the blade and reflect blows that strike it.

name: Fastening Feint
description: Hold the foe's blade against the crossguard with the qi field closing around it.

name: Ironfoible
description: Catch the foe's blade at a quillon and cut over it.

name: Leafhauberk
description: Keep the hilt before the chest with qi extending around the grip.

name: Beat Onslaught
description: Release from a bind with a thrust at the foe's hand.

name: Torrent Cutover
description: Step out of a bind to the foe's blind side.

name: Murk Crossbar
description: Turn the bound blades together to move the cut away from the body.

name: Chime Riposte
description: Twist the foe's blade out of his hand on the quillon with qi in the wrist.

name: Blazetang
description: Strike with the pommel while the blades stay locked.

name: Intentbeat
description: Press the bind with a steady flow of qi to weaken the foe's arm.

name: Scalding Glissade
description: Slide the edge along the bound blade and cut the foe's fingers.

name: Quelling Fuller
description: Close a long bind in which the foe's blade cannot move at all while the qi lasts.

name: Interlocking Intent Feint
description: Run a bind, a twist, a pommel strike and a thrust in unbroken order.

name: Rumble Quillon
description: Cut along one track while the guard hand holds the other in readiness.

name: Thorntang
description: Hold two guards in turn, high then low, with qi following the blade.

name: Forged Midrib
description: Thrust along the first line, then recover and thrust along the second.

name: Blurring Forte
description: Step along one lane and then the next so the foe cannot find the swordsman's line.

name: Tang Plating
description: Beat the foe's blade with the left edge, then the right, in a rapid pair.

name: Gust Ricasso
description: Change tracks mid-parry to meet a second cut from a new line.

name: Beat Maelstrom
description: Run two chains of cuts, one high and one low, with qi crossing between them.

name: Needling Foible
description: Sweep the blade along both tracks in a crossing pattern that cuts through the foe's flanks.

name: Facet Leaf
description: Hold both tracks tight so blows struck on one are returned along the other.

name: Glint Envelop
description: Drop the point onto the foe from above in a swift hawk-like descent.

name: Facet Fuller
description: Hold the sword high over the shoulder and wait, qi steady in the grip.

name: Skinning Forte
description: Cut wide with both arms, edge following a long arc like a spreading wing.

name: Torrent Glissade
description: Step in with short quick strides and plant the lead foot as the point falls.

name: Leafcuirass
description: Beat aside a cut with a downward swing and rise on the return.

name: Blaze Beat
description: Rise on the toes, then cut straight down with the whole body behind the edge.

name: Silencing Pommel
description: Circle the point over the foe's guard so his blade cannot rise.

name: Midrib Greave
description: Beat the blade left and right before the body in a pattern that shields against any cut.

name: Rumble Foible
description: Fall onto the foe from above with the point leading and qi driven through the blade.

name: Successive Crossbar
description: Run a stoop, a withdrawal, and a second stoop in a single unbroken motion.

name: Might Riposte
description: Cut across the foe's body in a flat arc with the blade held at the crossguard.

name: Granite Forte
description: Hold the blade level before the chest like a still basin with qi spread through it.

name: Glint Glissade
description: Thrust with both quillons ready to catch a counter.

name: Racing Riposte
description: Move forward with the smooth flow of a river around the foe's line.

name: Gyvemidrib
description: Cross blades and hold the foe's sword with a field of qi shaped like the crossguard.

name: Rumble Pommel
description: Wrench a foe's blade away with the twin quillons and a burst of qi.

name: Torrent Ricasso
description: Turn the blade in a basin-like circle that gathers the foe's cut and pours it aside.

name: Deedtang
description: Hold the foe's sword and guard under the crossguard so neither arm can move.

name: Doctrine Cutover
description: Run a cross cut, a river step, a bind and a thrust in one flow.

name: Rumble Envelop
description: Cut along a bending line that curves away from the foe's parry.

name: Thornmidrib
description: Hold a circular guard that catches and holds every cut that falls inside it.

name: Scalding Feint
description: Thrust along a line that appears to drift off then returns to the foe's throat.

name: Mightfuller
description: Step in a flowing curve that carries the swordsman around the foe's guard.

name: Gust Tang
description: Cut in a broad widening line that opens wider as the blade travels.

name: Gust Forte
description: Turn the blade in a small eddy that takes the foe's cut and spins it away.

name: Hoarfrost Leaf
description: Press the foe's sword down into a basin of qi so it cannot rise.

name: Blaze Foible
description: Send a rolling chain of cuts like a rising flood, each stronger than the last.

name: Scorching Daybreak Midrib
description: Surge a flat sweep of the blade outward like a river bursting its banks.

name: Veritymidrib
description: Gather a foe's blow in the basin guard and return it along the river's line.

name: Pommel Assault
description: Cut along the line of the wind with the blade swinging clear and open.

name: Forteplating
description: Hold the blade low and wide in an open guard that hides no part of the body.

name: Hollowpommel
description: Thrust with the weight of a running step as though driven by a gale.

name: Granite Glissade
description: Stride in long steps across open ground with the blade level.

name: Gust Fuller
description: Turn aside a cut with a loose parry that gives with the force of the blow.

name: Iron Quillon
description: Cut with a sworn edge that does not turn from the line once begun.

name: Toxinleaf
description: Take a bearing on the foe's blade and beat it from the line.

name: Ravaging Tang
description: Sweep the sword in a broad arc that cuts every foe on the open ground around.

name: Verity Leaf
description: Hold the open guard so blows that strike it rebound on the sender.

name: Rumble Riposte
description: Take a bearing on the foe's breast and thrust straight along it.

name: Thorn Crossbar
description: Keep the point on the foe's centre and hold the bearing as he moves.

name: Ricasso Torment
description: Cut from the plateau stance with the edge following the bearing of the arm.

name: Might Quillon
description: Step round the foe while holding the point on its bearing.

name: Annealed Midrib
description: Brush aside a cut with a sweeping parry that keeps the bearing.

name: Severing Cutover
description: Shift the bearing mid-cut so the blade turns to a new line.

name: Rumblebeat
description: Beat the foe's blade off the bearing and thrust in behind it.

name: Annealed Leaf
description: Hold the open guard on the plateau and let the wind of a sweeping parry turn the blow.

name: Shadetang
description: Hold the point on the foe's centre until he cannot advance or strike without exposing himself.

name: Compounding Envelop
description: Run a bearing, a shift, a thrust and a sworn cut in one line.

name: Iron Forte
description: Cut along the edge of open ground with long strides and a flat blade.

name: Hardened Quillon
description: Hold a guard that lets the qi field spread wide around the blade.

name: Beatbarrage
description: Thrust with a long stride that carries the point across the gap in one beat.

name: Torrent Pommel
description: Step in a line along the skyline, keeping the blade level on the horizon.

name: Equipoise Crossbar
description: Slip the blade off the foe's cut at the cliff's edge of the stance and cut back.

name: Ironmidrib
description: Chain cuts as though the blade rides the wind, each one fed by the last.

name: Tangcuirass
description: Hold the foe's blade open with a bind that leaves no wall between the swords.

name: Murkfoible
description: Turn aside a cut with a loose edge that bends before the blow.

name: Downpour Glissade
description: Sweep the blade in a wide oath-swearing arc that cuts all foes within reach of the swing.

name: Cutover Plating
description: Hold the foe's blade with a steady qi field until he must let go.

name: Needling Feint
description: Draw the sword and cut in a single stroke that the swordsman commits to fully.

name: Iron Fuller
description: Hold the blade open and level so no cover hides the body.

name: Rumbletang
description: Thrust with a point sworn to the foe's centre and held there.

name: Granite Riposte
description: Step on a bearing taken before the foe moves and keep it.

name: Lancing Beat
description: Return a sworn cut along the same open line after a parry with the point never leaving it.

name: Tang Greave
description: Parry in a way that commits the blade to the return cut.

name: Dominating Envelop
description: Bind the foe's blade with the wind at the swordsman's back and qi through the grip.

name: Rumble Feint
description: Beat the foe's blade open and step into the gap with a thrust.

name: Iron Tang
description: Gather a long breath and let the sworn thrust fly in one gale-driven lunge.

name: Glint Ricasso
description: Hold the blade open and turn a heavy blow back on the foe.
